basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with experience delivering full-stack features, APIs, and data pipelines for enterprise financial platforms and security tooling.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on enterprise financial platforms, leading feature delivery and cross-functional collaboration across international teams.
highlights: Led end-to-end delivery of production features and integrations, owning API design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
Built full-stack features with TypeScript, React, and Redux on the frontend and Spring Boot with Java 21 on the backend, integrating internal enterprise systems.
Optimized Oracle SQL schemas, JPA/Hibernate mappings, and Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions for high-throughput financial workloads.
Consolidated historical storage into Snowflake on Azure, reducing storage costs while maintaining high availability for cross-functional teams.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Built security tooling for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Built a React/Redux security dashboard for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
Resolved critical logic flaws in risk-scoring algorithms, improving data accuracy and reducing false-positive alerts for enterprise clients.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Developed full-stack automation solutions to streamline enterprise business processes.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation solutions with C#/.NET and SQL, streamlining enterprise workflows across OCR, HR, and fundraising departments.

projects.name: dossier
projects.description: Local-first CLI that runs OpenCode agent prompts to generate grounded resumes, proposals, and application answers from a career fact bank.
highlights: Built an OpenCode-agent pipeline that generates tailored resumes, proposals, and application answers from a local career fact bank
Recorded an evidence trace for every generated claim and verified outputs before rendering
Published a global CLI package with XDG data paths, mode-aware caching, and Puppeteer-based PDF rendering

projects.name: Meal Planner
projects.description: Full-stack household meal-planning application that turns shared weekly decisions into an actionable grocery workflow.
highlights: Delivered a multi-user SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Convex app with authentication, household onboarding, shared planning, real-time data, and a Google OAuth2 flow handling redirects and session state
Defined a focused product experience spanning meal management, weekly planning, household collaboration, leftover tracking, and synchronized shopping lists
